title: Stargate Community
summary: Stargate Community plans detail a community-first approach to AI infrastructure, using locally tailored plans shaped by community input, energy needs, and workforce priorities.
body: Stargate Community plans detail a community-first approach to AI infrastructure, using locally tailored plans shaped by community input, energy needs, and workforce priorities.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布关于Stargate社区的规划，强调通过本地化需求和能源考量来构建AI基础设施。该内容侧重于社区运营与宏观规划，缺乏技术层面的实质性更新。
